correctness.rationale: The displayed bracket realizes the free quotient: up to degree four, alternating brackets and Jacobi give spanning lists of lengths 2,1,2,3, with [u,y]=[v,x] the degree-four relation; the displayed eight-dimensional algebra realizes those dimensions (Jacobi in the only nontrivial distinct-generator triple uses that relation). The derived ideal is abelian, and the degree-four part is exactly the center. In the class-three quotient, after removing a lifted Heisenberg inner derivation a central almost-inner map sends x to lambda u and y to mu v. Its value at x+y has to be on the u+v line, so lambda=mu and the class-three map was inner. Lifting an inner adjustment leaves a central derivation on the original algebra killing its derived ideal. For a pure generator direction alpha x+beta y, its central commutator slice is the span of alpha a+beta b and alpha b+beta c; lower-degree brackets cannot add central directions by cancellation. The same span remains available after adding any derived-ideal vector, because the two bracket witnesses u,v commute with that ideal. For images (pa+hb,rb+sc), the membership determinant is alpha beta times alpha(s-h)+beta(p-r). The two axis cases are automatic. Two different nonzero scalars force s=h and p=r, precisely the central inner maps. In F2 only one equation remains, allowing the stated noninner representative. The center gives inner dimension five. An independent F2 replay enumerated every allowable pair of generator images, extended by the derivation identities, checked all basis pairs and all 256 pointwise conditions, and found 64 almost-inner maps, precisely 32 inner.
residual_risks: The replay is for F2 only; the proof for every field is the derived-ideal reduction and exact determinant test. Ordinary alternating Lie algebras, not restricted Lie algebras.

value.rationale: This is the first possible class in the canonical two-generator free series where the known rigidity statement can fail over F2. The explicit obstruction distinguishes field cardinality from characteristic, gives an exact local-versus-global witness over the smallest field, and identifies precisely when field extension removes it in this example. That is a motivated boundary of a known theorem, not a census of an arbitrary small algebra.
residual_risks: Does not classify higher nilpotency classes or other kinds of free algebras.
